name: AMO-Bench
intro: AMO-Bench由数学专家原创并给出逐步解答，经至少3名专家盲审、10-gram与网页原创性检查，以及人类IMO难度确认和多模型失败筛选，最终保留50题。每题生成32个回答；39题由解析器评分，11题由o4-mini五次裁判多数投票评分，混合评分器在1000个回答上达到99.2%准确率。
org: Meituan, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Harbin Institute of Technology
build_method: 数学专家原创出题, 三人以上盲审, 原创性与难度复核
metric: AVG@32, Pass@32, 输出长度与类别分解
eval_feature: IMO级难度, 原创防泄漏, 解析器与LLM混合评分
build_method_en: Expert-authored original problems, three-or-more-expert blind review, originality and difficulty review
eval_feature_en: IMO-level difficulty, original leakage-resistant tasks, parser and LLM hybrid grading
intro_en: AMO-Bench starts with original problems and step-by-step solutions written by mathematics experts, then applies blind review by at least three experts, 10-gram and web originality checks, human IMO-level difficulty confirmation, and multi-model failure filtering to retain 50 problems. Each model produces 32 responses per problem; 39 items use parser grading and 11 use five-vote o4-mini judging, with the hybrid grader reaching 99.2% accuracy on 1,000 responses.
metric_en: AVG@32, Pass@32, output length and category breakdowns
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2510.26768 and the official AMO-Bench project page. The diagram preserves the four construction stages: expert-authored problems with worked solutions; blind review by at least three experts; originality review using 10-gram matching against existing sets including AIME 2024/2025, web search, and expert memory; and difficulty review requiring human IMO-level-or-harder agreement plus consistent failure by at least two advanced models, where each model gets three samples and all three must be correct to count as a consistent solve. It also preserves the five category counts, 32 responses per model/problem, temperature 1.0 for reasoning models and 0.7 otherwise, top-k 50, top-p 0.95, maximum available length, 39 parser-graded items, 11 five-vote o4-mini (Low) items, 99.2% grader accuracy on 1,000 responses, AVG@32, Pass@32, and AMO-Bench-P.
